instruction.text: You are speaking to a doctor about different kinds of drugs. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Could you explain to me what counts as a ((++drug drink))?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.75st'>Could you explain to me what counts as a drug?</prosody>

atoms.b: Drugs are substances that change the way your body works. Lots of drugs are used to help people when they are ill. These are known as ((++medicines cigarettes)).
Is it always safe to ((++take spit_out)) medicine when you are feeling sick?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.75st'>Is it always safe to take medicine when you are feeling sick?</prosody>

atoms.b: You should always ask a trusted ((++adult child)) or doctor before taking medicine. Taking too much or the wrong kind of medicine can be dangerous.
What other ((++risks foods)) come with drugs?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.75st'>What other risks come with drugs?</prosody>

atoms.b: Some drugs, such as alcohol and nicotine, can be addictive. Alcohol is found in drinks like beer and ((++wine milk)), whereas nicotine is in cigarettes.

instruction.text: Select all of the different types of drugs.

feedback.end: Having an addiction means that you have a persistent need or strong craving for a substance, even when it is causing harm to your body.

instruction.text: Select the harmful effects of each substance.

feedback.end: Cigarettes contain tobacco and nicotine. The chemicals in tobacco can cause lots of damage to your throat and lungs. Nicotine is a highly addictive substance also found in electronic cigarettes.
If somebody consumes too much alcohol, they might experience headaches and slowed reactions. In the long term, alcohol can cause damage to the liver, heart and stomach.

instruction.text: Match each word to its definition.

atoms.b: is a persistent need or craving for a substance.
atoms.sound: Addiction is a persistent need or craving for a substance.

atoms.b: is a substance that changes the way your body works.
atoms.sound: A drug is a substance that changes the way your body works.

atoms.b: is a liquid contained in certain drinks like beer and wine.
atoms.sound: Alcohol is a liquid contained in certain drinks like beer and wine.
